reviewCoverage.identity: Own project and dated launch establish the community. The Sunset brief is phase-specific; its building, areas and completion target are not represented as universal terms for all components.
reviewCoverage.location: Developer launch identifies Island B of Dubai Islands. Mapped existing Dubai Islands area without invented coordinates.
reviewCoverage.residences: Primary launch describes one- to four-bedroom apartments/penthouses and three-/five-bedroom signature beachfront residences. Actual Sunset layouts cover one to four bedrooms with study, corner, dual-aspect and penthouse variations.
reviewCoverage.areas: Raster-only 83-page Sunset brief reviewed as rendered contact sheets; individual numerical panels65–76, configuration14 and summary15 visually read at full size. Twelve measured families recorded; summary discrepancies retained. Typical21-page Sunset and11-page Gardens packs retrieved but not used to invent individual Gardens sizes.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Own main page and launch support pools, fitness, yoga/Pilates, sports, play, mini-golf, coworking, jazz and dining spaces. Future community amenities, no guarantee of private access for every building.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Property Finder advertises AED 2.7 million, not a verified selected-unit developer offer. Primary ownpage/launch contains no current unit price.
reviewCoverage.payment: Actual official collection payment sheet visually read:20+10+eight5+30=100. No assumption that mirrored historical terms remain an offer for every unit.
reviewCoverage.handover: Sunset brief explicitly estimates Q22030, corroborated by portalJune2030. Kept as a phase-specific target, not completion or a guaranteed community-wide handover.
reviewCoverage.documents: Own brochure/brief/plans links returned404, recorded. Exact branded public broker mirrors retrieved and classified broker. Own payment PDF successful. Raster text extraction empty, so all adopted numeric facts read visually. Own archiveSeptember/October 2026 dates not treated as progress certification.

overview: Five residential buildings, signature beachfront residences and a hotel form the announced community. Apartments range from one to four bedrooms; the signature offering includes three- and five-bedroom homes. The layout examples below belong to Meriva Sunset.
research.locationNote: Island B, Dubai Islands. Beachfront positioning is developer-published; views and access rights depend on the chosen building and apartment.
research.priceNote: Property Finder advertises a starting reference of AED 2.7 million. Confirm the building, apartment and all charges with a dated quotation; no current availability is implied.
research.paymentNote: Published purchase instalments total100%:70% before completion and 30% at completion. Fees, reservation dates and contract-specific variations require confirmation.
research.handoverNote: The Meriva Sunset brief estimates Q2 2030; Property Finder lists June 2030. This is a forecast for the documented phase, not proof of completion or a guaranteed date for every community building.
